notes.title: Game Updates
Game Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Terrarium Lovers!

Thanks for playing Mini Gardens!

We've just released an update with these changes:
* Improvements in the performance of the game
* Added an option to disable post-processing

if you still have performance issues, please let me know.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Terrarium Lovers!

Thanks for playing Mini Gardens!

We've just released an update with these changes:
* Adjustment on the Hitbox size to delete a link
* New Achievements icons
* Improvements on tutorial after level 4
* Level indicator on the lower right corner
* Adjustment  on the Hitbox in the level selector
* Music and SFX volumes now starts on 70% and 90%


We've made the changes thanks to your suggestions and feedback. They are very welcome.

notes.title: Bug fix 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi, thank you so much for playing!
This update includes some bug fixes at the level selector screen.

Have fun!

notes.title: Mini Gardens is here! Let's play!
notes.notes:
Dear puzzle and garden lovers:

[b]Mini Gardens is available now![/b]

Connect the hose to sprinklers and watch your 🌹 instantly grow revealing a beautiful scene. 
Mini Gardens is a logic puzzle game that has a lovely aesthetic and is a fun couple of hours.

Play it now!

Follow our studio page on Steam to see updates on our games:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/robotizar/]https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/robotizar/[/url]
